units: pixels (x right, y down, full-resolution image coordinates) and seconds; no metric scale

camera.motion: static (mean abs grey difference of the ceiling region between frame 0 and 49 = 0.6 grey levels; no pan, no shake)
camera.view: frontal view of a classroom front wall; the wall/blackboard plane is parallel to the image plane (board edges horizontal/vertical). Both moving objects move parallel to this wall, so one px->metre scale applies (2D video).

cat.description: black-and-white (tuxedo) cat, black body, white paws, tail raised; walks left->right along the top of the teacher's desk
cat.occlusion: none (whole cat visible every frame; tail tip over dark board is low contrast in frames ~19-30)
cat.reference_point_recommended: torso_cx (horizontal centre of torso, no tail/legs) with cy_dark (centroid of the near-black body pixels) as vertical; bbox centre and mask centroid also given
cat.path: torso_cx 269.5 (f0) -> 703.0 (f49), i.e. 433.5 px in 49 frames (~8.85 px/frame mean), nearly horizontal; feet stay at y ~741 (desk top); vertical body bob of +-3 px with the gait

sizes_px.note: bbox includes the raised tail (tail tip is the top of the bbox, at y ~597-620); height_no_tail = feet to top of head/ears; frame 0 head-top/bbox slightly enlarged by a faint rendering ghost in front of the head (x~330-360)

paper_airplane.description: white paper airplane (pointed nose, folded wing/keel at rear), seen side-on; flies left->right in front of the wall, rising, levelling at the top of the blackboard, then descending
paper_airplane.partially_visible: frames 7-9 clipped by left image edge; 39-42 clipped by right edge; 7-12 and 34-42 over the grey wall where it is faint (dark grey, nose tip hard to see)
paper_airplane.reference_point_recommended: cx_best, cy_best (bbox centre where fully visible; centre reconstructed from the visible end +- half the full length otherwise; see best_method)

sizes_px.note: length is the full nose-to-tail length on the board (frames 14-33, PCA axis); height (wing/keel thickness seen from side) ~12-13 px with the strict threshold of track.py first pass, 15-23 px with the hysteresis mask (includes anti-aliasing halo)

path_summary.entry: frame 7 at left edge, centre est. (-28, 726)
path_summary.exit: frame 42 last visible pixels at right edge; centre est. (1986, 674); not visible from frame 43
path_summary.pitch: axis angle (image, + = nose down) goes from -15 deg (f7) through 0 deg at f23-24 to +17 deg (f38); nose follows the flight path

blackboard.description: green chalkboard with wooden (orange-brown) frame on the front wall, centre of image

wall_clock.description: round analog wall clock, white face, dark rim, upper right of board

teacher_desk.description: wooden teacher's desk at left, in front of the board's lower-left part; the cat walks on its top

student_chairs_and_desks.description: foreground dark-red/brown student chairs and small wooden student desks along the bottom of the frame (left x 0-260, centre x 660-925, right x 1300-1620, far right x 1875-1920), cut off by the bottom edge; one empty wooden chair against the wall at right (x 1600-1790, y 737-1010)

ceiling_lights.description: four rectangular ceiling light panels at top (y ~55-90), x ~40-230, 645-800, 1230-1390, 1800-1920

events.event: cat already walking (mid-stride) on desk top; continues the whole clip, no start/stop
paper airplane enters at left image edge (y ~713), climbing
paper airplane fully inside the image (over the grey wall)
airplane passes above the cat's raised tail (~10-30 px gap, no contact)
airplane crosses the board's left frame onto the green board
airplane apex (vertical velocity sign change; centre y min ~342 at frames 23-24), axis horizontal
airplane nose reaches the board's right frame (x ~1690); fully past the board at frame 36
airplane nose leaves the right image edge
last airplane pixels at right edge; gone from frame 43
clip ends, cat still walking (torso centre x ~703)
